default/32736.htm.text: General Ermian: We deployed on an exploration mission, one ship among many. In an unknown region we encountered something that, to this day, I can't describe. A large.. mass.. that shifted colors and shape... As soon as we came into contact with it our ships were pulled into some kind of powerful v…

Q00454_CompletelyLost/32736-01.html.text: General Ermian: What did you say?! You saw a wounded soldier still alive? You should have brought him here. We can't abandon our own here. Right now, it's our priority to save as many of the lost soldiers as possible and bring them back. If you see any, lead them here. Trust me, I'll make it worth …

Q00454_CompletelyLost/32736-02.html.text: General Ermian: You found him wandering the Seed? It's a miracle he's still alive! You truly saved his life. Allow me to thank you... here. You deserve more for what you've done but for now, this is all I have to give.

Q00454_CompletelyLost/32736-03.html.text: General Ermian: I can't thank you enough! In this world, there are too few men and women who would answer the call to help someone the way you just did, and even fewer who would be able to in this nightmarish place. Rest up. You've earned it!
